theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the strongest eligible theme on the only validated leg: durability_bar 0.62 (highest among top-ranked eligible themes) with trend-gate eligibility and a mixed Hurst tag, meaning it has passed the absolute-trend filter that historically cuts drawdown. It sits a hair behind Base Metals on raw momentum score but with materially stronger internal durability and better breadth (0.5 vs 0.333), suggesting leadership is less fragile. The crowding flag is absent (z=0.88, not crowded).
